profile.name: Daravath Saathvik
profile.tagline: Game designer with a marketer's toolkit. I build worlds, stories and play at NID, and plan the campaigns and creatives that help them find players and sell.
profile.about:
I'm a game designer with a background in Game and Interactive Media Design (BA Hons) from JNAFAU, currently pursuing a Master of Design in Digital Game Design at the National Institute of Design (NID).

At MaxLink Group of Companies I work in digital marketing and design: I manage paid media across Meta Ads and Google Ads and create static and video ad creatives. Alongside that, my academic and independent projects span game art, 3D environments and interactive storytelling.

I enjoy blending creativity with design strategy to craft engaging player experiences.
profile.summary: Game designer pursuing a Master of Design (M.Des) in Digital Game Design at the National Institute of Design (NID), with a BA (Hons) in Game and Interactive Media Design from JNAFAU. Experienced in digital marketing and visual design at MaxLink Group of Companies: managed nearly ₹1 crore in Meta Ads and Google Ads spend at 5× ROAS and produced static and video ad creatives in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro. Academic and independent work spans game art, 3D environments (Unreal Engine 5, Autodesk Maya) and interactive storytelling.

experience.description:
Managed nearly ₹1 crore in paid media across Meta Ads and Google Ads, achieving 5× ROAS through data-led audience targeting, creative testing and budget optimisation.
Led full-funnel campaign strategy for CapShap, Yosha and Hudhawk, turning product launches and brand goals into conversion-focused digital campaigns.
Created performance-led static and video ad creatives in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro, tailored for Meta and Google placements.
Analysed campaign performance to refine targeting, messaging and creative direction, keeping acquisition aligned with profitable growth goals.

Designed high-impact static and video creatives for CapShap, Yosha and Hudhawk, maintaining a consistent visual identity across campaigns.
Produced paid-ad, social-media and promotional assets in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro, adapting each creative to its channel and audience.
Collaborated with marketing teams to turn campaign briefs into clear, conversion-focused visuals for product launches and brand promotions.
Iterated on creative concepts using campaign feedback, improving the relevance and effectiveness of visual communication across digital touchpoints.
